component.name: aws2-iam
component.title: AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM)
component.description: Manage users, groups, roles, managed policies, access keys and instance profiles in AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM).
component.label: cloud,management

configuration.description: The configuration that the endpoints of the component start from. Each endpoint uses a copy of it, in which its own URI options replace the values.

iamClient.description: To use a custom software.amazon.awssdk.services.iam.IamClient. When this option is set or autowired, the credentials, region, proxy, endpoint override and trustAllCertificates options are not used to build a client. The Camel endpoint does not close a client that is set or autowired.

lazyStartProducer.label: producer
lazyStartProducer.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.

operation.description: The operation that the producer performs. The CamelAwsIAMOperation header replaces this option. If neither is set, the exchange fails.

overrideEndpoint.description: Whether to send the requests to the URI of the uriEndpointOverride option instead of the endpoint of the region. It has no effect when uriEndpointOverride is not set.

pojoRequest.description: Whether the body is the request object of the AWS SDK for the operation, such as a CreateUserRequest, which the producer sends as it is. The headers that give the input of the operation are then not used, and an empty body or a body of another type fails the exchange.

region.description: The AWS region of the IAM client, as a region ID such as aws-global, which is the value of Region.AWS_GLOBAL.id(). IAM is a global service: the default aws-global is for the standard AWS partition, and aws-cn-global and aws-us-gov-global are for the China and AWS GovCloud (US) partitions.

uriEndpointOverride.description: The URI of the endpoint to use instead of the endpoint of the region, for example http://localhost:4566 for a local emulator. It is used only when overrideEndpoint is true.

autowiredEnabled.label: advanced
autowiredEnabled.description: Whether autowiring is enabled. This is used for automatic autowiring options (the option must be marked as autowired) by looking up in the registry to find if there is a single instance of matching type, which then gets configured on the component. This can be used for automatic configuring JDBC data sources, JMS connection factories, AWS Clients, etc.

healthCheckConsumerEnabled.label: health
healthCheckConsumerEnabled.description: Used for enabling or disabling all consumer based health checks from this component

healthCheckProducerEnabled.label: health
healthCheckProducerEnabled.description: Used for enabling or disabling all producer based health checks from this component. Notice: Camel has by default disabled all producer based health-checks. You can turn on producer checks globally by setting camel.health.producersEnabled=true.

proxyHost.label: proxy
proxyHost.description: The host name of the proxy that the HTTP client of IAM connects through. The proxy is used only when the proxyPort option is set too.

proxyPort.label: proxy
proxyPort.description: The port of the proxy that the HTTP client of IAM connects through. The proxy is used only when the proxyHost option is set too.

proxyProtocol.label: proxy
proxyProtocol.description: The protocol that the HTTP client of IAM uses to connect to the proxy. It is used only when the proxyHost and proxyPort options are set.

accessKey.label: security
accessKey.description: The access key ID of the AWS credentials, used together with the secretKey option. It is not used when useDefaultCredentialsProvider or useProfileCredentialsProvider is true.

profileCredentialsName.label: security
profileCredentialsName.description: The name of the profile in the AWS shared credentials and config files, used when useProfileCredentialsProvider is true. If not set, the AWS SDK uses its default profile, which the AWS_PROFILE environment variable can change.

secretKey.label: security
secretKey.description: The secret access key of the AWS credentials, used together with the accessKey option. It is not used when useDefaultCredentialsProvider or useProfileCredentialsProvider is true.

sessionToken.label: security
sessionToken.description: The session token of temporary AWS credentials, for example of an assumed IAM role. It is used only when useSessionCredentials is true, together with the accessKey and secretKey options.

trustAllCertificates.label: security
trustAllCertificates.description: Whether the HTTP client of IAM trusts every TLS certificate without checking it. It applies to any endpoint, not only to an overridden one, so use it only for testing, for example against a local emulator.

useDefaultCredentialsProvider.label: security
useDefaultCredentialsProvider.description: Whether to load the credentials with the default credentials provider chain of the AWS SDK, which looks in system properties, environment variables, the shared credentials and config files, and the container or instance role. It takes precedence over the other credentials options.

useProfileCredentialsProvider.label: security
useProfileCredentialsProvider.description: Whether to load the credentials from a profile of the AWS shared credentials and config files, the one of the profileCredentialsName option. It is not used when useDefaultCredentialsProvider is true, and it takes precedence over the session and static credentials.

useSessionCredentials.label: security
useSessionCredentials.description: Whether to use temporary credentials made of the accessKey, secretKey and sessionToken options, for example those of an assumed IAM role. It is not used when useDefaultCredentialsProvider or useProfileCredentialsProvider is true.

CamelAwsIAMOperation.description: The operation that the producer performs. It replaces the operation option.

CamelAwsIAMUsername.description: The name of the IAM user. createUser, deleteUser, getUser, addUserToGroup, removeUserFromGroup, attachUserPolicy and detachUserPolicy require it. listAccessKeys, createAccessKey, deleteAccessKey and updateAccessKey use it to select the user of the access key; when not set, IAM takes the user of the access key that signs the request.

CamelAwsIAMAccessKeyID.description: The ID of the access key that deleteAccessKey deletes or updateAccessKey updates. Both operations require it.

CamelAwsIAMAccessKeyStatus.description: The status that updateAccessKey sets on the access key: Active or Inactive, in any case. updateAccessKey requires it, and another value fails the exchange.

CamelAwsIAMGroupName.description: The name of the IAM group. createGroup, deleteGroup, addUserToGroup, removeUserFromGroup, attachGroupPolicy and detachGroupPolicy require it.

CamelAwsIAMGroupPath.description: The path of the group that createGroup creates, such as /division_abc/. When not set, IAM uses the path /.

CamelAwsIAMMarker.description: The marker of the CamelAwsIAMNextMarker header of the previous response, to get the next page of results of a list operation: listAccessKeys, listUsers, listGroups, listRoles, listPolicies or listInstanceProfiles.

CamelAwsIAMMaxItems.description: The maximum number of items in one page of results of a list operation: listAccessKeys, listUsers, listGroups, listRoles, listPolicies or listInstanceProfiles. IAM accepts 1 to 1000, and returns at most 100 items when not set.

CamelAwsIAMIsTruncated.description: Whether a list operation has more results than it returned. When true, the CamelAwsIAMNextMarker header gives the marker of the next page.

CamelAwsIAMNextMarker.description: The marker that a list operation sets when it has more results. Send it in the CamelAwsIAMMarker header to get the next page.

CamelAwsIAMUserArn.description: The ARN of the user that createUser created or getUser returned.

CamelAwsIAMUserId.description: The unique ID that IAM gave to the user that createUser created or getUser returned.

CamelAwsIAMGroupArn.description: The ARN of the group that createGroup created.

CamelAwsIAMGroupId.description: The unique ID that IAM gave to the group that createGroup created.

CamelAwsIAMRoleName.description: The name of the IAM role. createRole, deleteRole, getRole, attachRolePolicy, detachRolePolicy, addRoleToInstanceProfile and removeRoleFromInstanceProfile require it.

CamelAwsIAMRolePath.description: The path of the role that createRole creates. When not set, IAM uses the path /.

CamelAwsIAMAssumeRolePolicyDocument.description: The trust policy of the role that createRole creates, as a JSON policy document that says which principals can assume the role. createRole requires it.

CamelAwsIAMRoleArn.description: The ARN of the role that createRole created or getRole returned.

CamelAwsIAMRoleId.description: The unique ID that IAM gave to the role that createRole created or getRole returned.

CamelAwsIAMRoleDescription.description: The description of the role that createRole creates.

CamelAwsIAMPolicyName.description: The name of the managed policy that createPolicy creates. createPolicy requires it.

CamelAwsIAMPolicyPath.description: The path of the managed policy that createPolicy creates. When not set, IAM uses the path /.

CamelAwsIAMPolicyDocument.description: The JSON policy document of the managed policy that createPolicy creates, with the permissions of the policy. createPolicy requires it.

CamelAwsIAMPolicyArn.description: The ARN of the managed policy. deletePolicy, getPolicy and the operations that attach a policy to or detach it from a user, group or role require it. createPolicy and getPolicy set it to the ARN of the created or returned policy.

CamelAwsIAMPolicyId.description: The unique ID that IAM gave to the managed policy that createPolicy created or getPolicy returned.

CamelAwsIAMPolicyDescription.description: The description of the managed policy that createPolicy creates.

CamelAwsIAMInstanceProfileName.description: The name of the instance profile. createInstanceProfile, deleteInstanceProfile, getInstanceProfile, addRoleToInstanceProfile and removeRoleFromInstanceProfile require it.

CamelAwsIAMInstanceProfilePath.description: The path of the instance profile that createInstanceProfile creates. When not set, IAM uses the path /.

CamelAwsIAMInstanceProfileArn.description: The ARN of the instance profile that createInstanceProfile created or getInstanceProfile returned.

CamelAwsIAMInstanceProfileId.description: The unique ID that IAM gave to the instance profile that createInstanceProfile created or getInstanceProfile returned.

producerIn.description: Not used: the names, the ARNs and the policy documents come from headers, such as CamelAwsIAMUsername. With pojoRequest=true the request of the AWS SDK for the operation, such as a CreateUserRequest: another body fails

producerOut.description: The response of the AWS SDK for the operation, such as the CreateUserResponse of createUser; the create and get operations put the ARN and the id in headers too
